name: Dwaraka Caterers & Event Planners
address: Kodakara Vellikulangara Rd, Near check post, Kodakara, Keralam 680684

reviews.name: Renjith Asok
reviews.quote: Food Everyone Loved One of the things we’ll always remember about our wedding reception is the amazing food served by Dwaraka Caterers. ❤️ We personally loved the food, but what made us even happier was hearing the same from so many of our guests. The compliments kept coming throughout the day — and that says everything!

reviews.name: Abay Ashok
reviews.quote: A heartfelt thanks to Akhil bro and the entire team for your outstanding coordination and creativity. Everything was organized so smoothly and elegantly. Thank you for turning our special occasion into a grand success,and all our guests enjoyed every moment.From decoration to coordination, everything was perfect.

reviews.name: ARUN VENUGOPAL
reviews.quote: We had our wedding reception at Dwaraka, and I honestly can’t express how happy we are with the experience! They made our special day absolutely marvelous and far beyond our expectations. The food was truly out of the world — every guest personally appreciated the taste, quality, and presentation.

reviews.name: Athira Menon
reviews.quote: It’s been almost a year since I chose Dwaraka Caterers & Event Planners for the most special week of my life, and I still feel so grateful for their incredible support. From my engagement through the henna/sangeet nights, wedding eve, and the wedding day itself, Akhil and the team were with me every step of the way.

reviews.name: Athul K.S
reviews.quote: We had our wedding reception on 22nd August, and we are extremely happy with how beautifully everything was organised by Dwaraka Event & Caterers. From the arrangements and coordination to the overall execution, the team handled everything so professionally and seamlessly.
